narrative: On the tables. The pocket tables open on the desk at the lodging, the leaves small and erasable, a stylus beside them. The old line for Edith is still there. Under it, one new line for the gown. No total.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the line and did not pay it.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named on the line as the man who brought the figure. He was not in the room.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Her eight shillings stayed where January had put them. She was not in the room.

entities.name: the writing tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Fifty shillings, on the tables

entities.name: the Princess's gown
entities.context: Shown on tables in Fifty shillings, on the tables
